Name: Acqua Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

My newest creation, Acqua Farm, I created it for myself, because I like things of the right size, I'm playing it right now.

It replaces the Wilderness Farm, but if you don't want the night monster spawn you need to uncheck it at the beginning of the game. it has both ocean and freshwater fish and also the Crab Pot in the ocean have ocean forage and freshwater forage in river.

On the beach you have both beach forage and Supply Crates, everything is diggable, grass, dirt, beach.
It has the pet barriers on the left where you see the coop built in my screenshot,
If you also install my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19498]Green Farm Cave[/url] mod to have the dream farm, lots of fishing and everything small.
Edit:
New version, fiixed minor graphical flaw and added seasonal forage spawn.
Added large trees, improved farm graphics.
Installation: Remove the old one and install the new one.
Version 1.0.3 fixed small graphic detail.
In recent versions I have made small improvements.

I improved the farm, could there not be the Amazing ConcernedApe waterfalls on my farm? I absolutely had to have them; I posted it as an optional version.
I love these waterfalls they are so complex!
This is my gift to everyone, if you already have my farm in a save you can easily replace it with this new one, and remove the old one, because I only changed the waterfalls.
I added, thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5014796]magoozor[/url] advice the update key.
I hope you enjoy my work, have fun!

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.

On this farm I also use my latest creation:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20130]Relaxing Greenhouse[/url]
and my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19498]Green Farm Cave[/url]
also my
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20430]Comfortable Slime Hutch[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20934]Kana's Cellar[/url]

I welcome suggestions or messages, let me know if any bugs pop up.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

Enjoy!

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
